name: local-coding
description: Experimental. Hand large, mechanical sub-tasks (big reads, log and test triage, and the same edit across many files) from a cloud Copilot CLI session to the on-device MAI Code 1.1 Flash model on Windows, through an offload agent (the main session checks every DONE reply) or the on-device-delegate skill. Includes scripts to cap the local model's output tokens and to install or update the plugin.
